title: The Slow Language
author: Y. M. Nystrom
blurb: Yara Ishikawa, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
